title: 115. Movie Rating
markdown:
## 문제 Table: Movies ```plaintext +---------------+---------+ | Column Name | Type | +---------------+---------+ | movie_id | int | | title | varchar | +---------------+---------+ movie_id is the primary key (column with unique values) for this table. title is the name of the movie. ``` Table: Users ```plaintext +---------------+---------+ | Column Name | Type | +---------------+---------+ | user_id | int | | name | varchar | +---------------+---------+ user_id is the primary key (column with unique values) for this table. The column 'name' has unique values. ``` Table: MovieRating ```plaintext +---------------+---------+ | Column Name | Type | +---------------+---------+ | movie_id | int | | user_id | int | | rating | int | | created_at | date | +---------------+---------+ (movie_id, user_id) is the primary key (column with unique values) for this table. This table contains the rating of a movie by a user in their review. created_at is the user's review date. ``` Write a solution to: - Find the name of the user who has rated the greatest number of movies. In case of a tie, return the lexicographically smaller user name. - Find the movie name with the highest average rating in February 2020. In case of a tie, return the lexicographically smaller movie name. The result format is in the following example. Example 1: ```plaintext Input: Movies table: +-------------+--------------+ | movie_id | title | +-------------+--------------+ | 1 | Avengers | | 2 | Frozen 2 | | 3 | Joker | +-------------+--------------+ Users table: +-------------+--------------+ | user_id | name | +-------------+--------------+ | 1 | Daniel | | 2 | Monica | | 3 | Maria | | 4 | James | +-------------+--------------+ MovieRating table: +-------------+--------------+--------------+-------------+ | movie_id | user_id | rating | created_at | +-------------+--------------+--------------+-------------+ | 1 | 1 | 3 | 2020-01-12 | | 1 | 2 | 4 | 2020-02-11 | | 1 | 3 | 2 | 2020-02-12 | | 1 | 4 | 1 | 2020-01-01 | | 2 | 1 | 5 | 2020-02-17 | | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2020-02-01 | | 2 | 3 | 2 | 2020-03-01 | | 3 | 1 | 3 | 2020-02-22 | | 3 | 2 | 4 | 2020-02-25 | +-------------+--------------+--------------+-------------+ Output: +--------------+ | results | +--------------+ | Daniel | | Frozen 2 | +--------------+ Explanation: Daniel and Monica have rated 3 movies ("Avengers", "Frozen 2" and "Joker") but Daniel is smaller lexicographically. Frozen 2 and Joker have a rating average of 3.5 in February but Frozen 2 is smaller lexicographically. ``` ## 풀이 ### 조건 1. 가장 많은 영화에 평점을 준 사용자 찾기 - 각 사용자가 평점을 준 영화의 개수를 센다. - 개수를 기준으로 내림차순 정렬한다. - 만약 동률인 경우, 사용자의 이름을 사전순(알파벳순)으로 정렬한다. 1. 2020년 2월에 평균 평점이 가장 높은 영화 찾기 - MovieRating 테이블에서 2020년 2월에 작성된 평점 데이터를 필터링한다. - 각 영화의 평균 평점을 계산한다. - 평균 평점을 기준으로 내림차순 정렬한다. - 동률인 경우, 영화 제목을 사전순으로 정렬한다. 1. 결과를 요구된 형식으로 출력 - 두 결과를 하나로 결합한다. ### 풀이 1
Input ```sql Movies = | movie_id | title | | -------- | -------- | | 1 | Avengers | | 2 | Frozen 2 | | 3 | Joker | Users = | user_id | name | | ------- | ------ | | 1 | Daniel | | 2 | Monica | | 3 | Maria | | 4 | James | MovieRating = | movie_id | user_id | rating | created_at | | -------- | ------- | ------ | ---------- | | 1 | 1 | 3 | 2020-01-12 | | 1 | 2 | 4 | 2020-02-11 | | 1 | 3 | 2 | 2020-02-12 | | 1 | 4 | 1 | 2020-01-01 | | 2 | 1 | 5 | 2020-02-17 | | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2020-02-01 | | 2 | 3 | 2 | 2020-03-01 | | 3 | 1 | 3 | 2020-02-22 | | 3 | 2 | 4 | 2020-02-25 | ```
Output ```sql | results | | -------- | | Daniel | | Frozen 2 | ``` - Expected ```sql | results | | -------- | | Daniel | | Frozen 2 | ```
```sql -- Step 1: 가장 많은 평점을 준 사용자 찾기 WITH UserRatings AS ( SELECT u.name AS user_name, COUNT(mr.movie_id) AS rating_count FROM Users u JOIN MovieRating mr ON u.user_id = mr.user_id GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY rating_count DESC, user_name ASC LIMIT 1 ), -- Step 2: 2020년 2월에 평균 평점이 가장 높은 영화 찾기 MovieAverageRatings AS ( SELECT m.title AS movie_title, AVG(mr.rating) AS average_rating FROM Movies m JOIN MovieRating mr ON m.movie_id = mr.movie_id WHERE mr.created_at BETWEEN '2020-02-01' AND '2020-02-29' GROUP BY m.title ORDER BY average_rating DESC, movie_title ASC LIMIT 1 ) -- Step 3: 결과 합치기 SELECT user_name AS results FROM UserRatings UNION ALL SELECT movie_title AS results FROM MovieAverageRatings; ``` ### 풀이 2 ```sql -- 1. 가장 많은 평점을 준 사용자 찾기 (SELECT name AS results FROM MovieRating JOIN Users USING(user_id) GROUP BY name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, name LIMIT 1) UNION ALL --결과 합침 -- 2. 2020년 2월에 평균 평점이 가장 높은 영화 찾기 (SELECT title AS results FROM MovieRating JOIN Movies USING(movie_id) WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR_MONTH FROM created_at) = 202002 GROUP BY title ORDER BY AVG(rating) DESC, title LIMIT 1); ```
